description: Take payments with your own Razorpay account: create orders and payment links, invoice customers, capture and refund payments, keep customers in step, and see settlements. Start workflows when a payment is captured, an order or payment link is paid, or a refund is made.

razorpay_new_payment_trigger.description: Runs when a payment is captured in your Razorpay account: paid and kept, from Checkout, a payment link, an invoice or anywhere else.

razorpay_new_refund_trigger.description: Runs when a refund is made in your Razorpay account, from the Dashboard, a workflow or anywhere else.

razorpay_order_paid_trigger.description: Runs when an order in your Razorpay account is fully paid, with its receipt number and notes and the payment that paid it.

razorpay_payment_link_paid_trigger.description: Runs when a Razorpay payment link is fully paid, with its reference, customer and the payment that completed it.
